tour.body_en: EW VERDORA is a Kuching flower company with five lines: condolence, opening, bouquets, weddings and wholesale.
tour.body_zh: EW VERDORA 是古晋花店，有五大业务线。

tour.body_en: Condolence wreaths, opening baskets, refined bouquets, wedding & events, and wholesale flowers.
tour.body_zh: 帛事花圈、开张花篮、精致花束、婚礼活动、鲜花批发。

tour.body_en: You earn commission after a completed order. No need to discuss rates here.
tour.body_zh: 完成订单后可获得佣金。

tour.body_en: Finish the 7 required courses and pass the certification exam with 85% or higher.
tour.body_zh: 完成7个必修课＋认证考试85%以上。

coach_marks.tip_en: You apply; tell guest date and budget.
coach_marks.tip_zh: 你来申请，问客人日期预算。

empty_states.body_en: Start conversations on WhatsApp. When you have a lead, add it here.
empty_states.body_zh: 先在WhatsApp跟客人聊。有线索再加进来。

empty_states.body_en: Orders appear here once a customer confirms. Start with today's follow-ups.
empty_states.body_zh: 客人确认后，订单会出现在这里。先从今日跟进开始。

empty_states.body_en: When a guest is ready, ask for date and budget, then apply here.
empty_states.body_zh: 客人准备好时，问日期和预算，再来申请。

empty_states.body_en: Content will appear after it is published. Check back soon.
empty_states.body_zh: 内容发布后就会显示。稍后再看。

empty_states.body_en: Well done. Rest or review the handbook if you like.
empty_states.body_zh: 做得好。可以休息或再复习手册。

prompts_en: Remind me of the five product lines.
What is the focus for Day 2?
How do I practice a condolence message?
What score do I need for certification?
Who is suitable for opening baskets?
How should I reply to a photo request?
What areas do we deliver to?
prompts_zh: 开张花篮适合推荐给谁？

prompts_en: What do I ask the guest before applying?
How do I explain current quote?
prompts_zh: 申请报价前要问客人什么？

prompts_en: Give me a soft opening for a funeral.
How do I handle a negative review mention?
Is Samarahan in the delivery area?
prompts_zh: 给我一条温和的丧事开场。

aiTodayFirstHint.en: I picked the customers most worth contacting now and wrote the first message for you.
aiTodayFirstHint.zh: 我已经帮你排好现在最值得先联系的客人，也写好第一句。

aiTodayFirstLoading.zh: 正在帮你排今天先联系谁…

aiTodayFirstEmpty.en: No customer needs attention right now. You can focus on finding new enquiries.
aiTodayFirstEmpty.zh: 现在没有客人需要马上跟进，可以先去找新的询问。

aiConversationTitle.en: Turn a chat into a customer
aiConversationTitle.zh: 贴对话，帮我整理成客人

aiConversationHint.en: Paste the WhatsApp conversation. I’ll pull out the useful details, then you check them before saving.
aiConversationHint.zh: 把 WhatsApp 对话贴进来。我先抓重点，你确认没问题才保存。

aiConversationPaste.zh: 把客人的对话贴在这里…

aiConversationReviewHint.en: I only suggest the details. Edit anything that is not right.
aiConversationReviewHint.zh: 这些只是建议，有不对可以直接改。

aiObjectionTitle.en: Customer said this — what do I reply?

aiObjectionHint.en: Tap a common situation or paste the customer's words. I'll give you 3 safe replies to choose from.
aiObjectionHint.zh: 点一个常见情况，或者贴客人的原话。我给你 3 种安全回法，你选一条就好。

aiFollowupScheduleTitle.en: When should I contact this customer again?

aiFollowupScheduleHint.en: I’ll suggest a sensible time. You choose whether to save it.
aiFollowupScheduleHint.zh: 我先建议一个时间，你确认了才会保存。

aiFollowupScheduled.zh: 下次联系时间已经保存。

aiRepeatTitle.en: Previous customers you can check in with

aiRepeatHint.en: These are real customers who bought before. I wrote a light check-in — use it only if it feels appropriate.
aiRepeatHint.zh: 这些都是真的买过的客人。我写了一句轻轻问候，适合才发，不要硬推。

aiRepeatLoading.zh: 正在看你以前成交过的客人…

aiRepeatEmpty.en: No previous customer is ready for a check-in yet.
aiRepeatEmpty.zh: 现在还没有适合重新联系的旧客。

aiMicroTipTitle.en: One quick tip before you do this

aiMicroTipLoading.en: Getting one useful tip for this step…
aiMicroTipLoading.zh: 正在看这一步最需要注意什么…
